Businesses should work against corruption in all its forms, including extortion 
and bribery.
column5:
Intel has set clear standards and policies, and has put in place training to ensure employee compliance on these topics, including a reference in the 
Intel Code of Conduct. We have a comprehensive Ethics and Compliance program, which is described in detail in the Our Business and Integrated 
Value Approach section of this report. Depending on their role and geographical location, certain employees are assigned more in-depth ethics 
and compliance training courses, including those covering anti-corruption. Approximately 35,000 employees were trained on our anti-corruption 
policies and procedures in 2012. For more information see the Our Business and Integrated Value Approach section of this report.
